long_biography.plain_text:
Ahmet Rifat Sert co-chairs an Antalya-based development business created by two established regional builders. Its portfolio spans apartment complexes, hotels, educational facilities and sports construction, with projects including La Mare Lara, Kundu Kanyon and Sorgun Kanyon.

Sert's public comments focus on Antalya's appeal to property investors. He has linked the city's year-round tourism economy, airport expansion, international connections and quality of life with future residential and commercial demand. He is also a shareholder in a private company alongside Rıdvan Güzel, adding ownership to his executive responsibilities in the regional business network.
